facts.text: Villa Gallici is set in an elegant 18th-century residence.
facts.excerpt: The hotel _La Villa Gallici_ welcomes you to an elegant 18th century residence.

facts.text: Villa Gallici is a 5-star Relais & Chateaux hotel.
facts.excerpt: This **5-star Relais & Châteaux** hotel offers top-of-the-range facilities

facts.text: The house opens onto a garden filled with the fragrances of Provence, with cypress trees sheltering the outdoor swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: The country home opens out on to a garden filled with the sweet fragrances of Provence, with cypress trees sheltering the outdoor swimming pool.

facts.text: The Provencal residence has refined baroque decoration.
facts.excerpt: The spirit of Villa Gallici, a Provençal residence dating from the 18th century, is embodied through a refined baroque decoration

facts.text: The hotel is a few minutes' walk from the centre of Aix-en-Provence.
facts.excerpt: located just a few minutes' walk from the centre of Aix-en-Provence

facts.text: The hotel is a 15-minute walk to Cours Mirabeau, yet has a quiet, countryside seclusion.
facts.excerpt: a draw for both its proximity to Aix-en-Provence (it's a 15-minute walk to Cours Mirabeau) and quiet, countryside seclusion

facts.text: Rooms have a hushed boudoir atmosphere, comfortable wing chairs and design inspired by French art de vivre with touches of exoticism.
facts.excerpt: A hushed boudoir atmosphere, comfortable wing chairs, an interior design inspired by a certain French-style way of life, elegant touches of exoticism

facts.text: Rooms and suites have either a private garden or views of the grounds, and are furnished in toile, cream and crimson Louis XV pieces.
facts.excerpt: have either a private garden or views of the sprawling grounds, and each one is outfitted in toile, cream, and crimson Louis XV furnishings

facts.text: The hotel has a 2-hectare garden.
facts.excerpt: - 2-hectare garden

facts.text: The outdoor swimming pool is heated.
facts.excerpt: - Heated outdoor swimming pool

facts.text: The spa has two treatment rooms, a sauna, a Jacuzzi, cryotherapy and fitness.
facts.excerpt: - SPA (2 Rooms treatments, Sauna, Jacuzzi, Cryoterapy, Fitness)

facts.text: La Taula Gallici is the gourmet restaurant, with seasonal cuisine inspired by Provence and Italy by Chef Christophe Gavot, served in the shade of plane trees.
facts.excerpt: À l’ombre des platanes, dégustez une cuisine de saison inspirée de la Provence et de l'Italie. Les saveurs méditerranéennes sont associées avec inventivité par le Chef Christophe GAVOT

facts.text: La Dolce Serata is an Italian restaurant open from June to September.
facts.excerpt: - La Dolce Serata : Italian restaurant June to September.

facts.text: The hotel has an on-site wine cellar.
facts.excerpt: The outdoor pool is, of course, a highlight, as is the on-site wine cellar and spa.

facts.text: Room choices range from the classic room to a private villa set in the French-style gardens.
facts.excerpt: allant de la chambre classique à la villa privative située dans nos jardins à la Française

facts.text: The setting blends the Provencal art of living with Italian dolce vita.
facts.excerpt: un subtil mélange entre l'art de vivre Provençal et la dolce vita Italienne

facts.text: Rooms have majestic beds and Louis XV writing desks.
facts.excerpt: lits majestueux, secrétaires Louis XV ainsi qu'une multitude d'ornements

facts.text: Parking is available at a supplement.
facts.excerpt: - Parking (Supplement)

facts.text: The hotel is surrounded by lavender and cypress trees.
facts.excerpt: Housed in an 18th-century mansion surrounded by lavender and cypress trees

facts.text: The hotel offers a concierge service and free Wi-Fi throughout.
facts.excerpt: - Free Wi-Fi access throughout the hotel
